name: set_battery_charge
summary: Cheat: set the charge of single batteries (station and rocket batteries, battery cells anywhere), full by default or to a ratio or joules. Ask the user first. Dry run by default; confirm to set.

help.text: Name the batteries with reference_ids (up to 256, each checked alone), rocket_id (every battery of that rocket) or in_id (every battery cell in a thing's slots, its suit, tools and their slots too; "player" for the player). ratio (0 to 1) or joules sets that charge instead of full; joules over a battery's capacity fill it (clamped). Each result gives the charge before and after, so a later call can put it back. The console's setbatteries sets every battery in the world at once; this one sets only those named. Host only: clients see the new charge through the game's own sync.
help.keys: dry_run, goal, found_in, results, count, success_count, error_count, added_j.

batteries.text: Every power store the game has: placed batteries (Station Battery, Large Station Battery: kind station_battery), the batteries built into a rocket (rocket_battery), battery cells of every size, the wireless cell among them, loose or in any slot (battery_cell; held_by names the suit, tool, APC, charger or locker holding it), a power pylon end's small buffer (pylon_buffer), and anything else the game charges as a battery (other_chargeable). A Disposable Battery Charger is a consumable, not a battery.

reply.text: {dry_run, goal {kind full|ratio|joules, value}, found_in (the rocket or holder searched), results, count, success_count, error_count, added_j (joules the run adds, negative when it drains)}. A result: {index, ok, reference_id, prefab_name, display_name, kind, held_by, capacity_j, before_j, after_j, before_ratio, after_ratio, clamped}; a dry run predicts after_j, a real run reads it back. A failure: {index, ok: false, reference_id, error}.

refusals.summary: Why a battery is not set.
refusals.text: Per id: not_a_battery (the message names what the thing is, and points at in_id when its slots hold cells), thing_not_found, invalid_argument. For the whole call: no_batteries (the rocket or holder has none), too_many_batteries (over 256 found; name them in reference_ids calls), rocket_not_found, not_host, confirm_required.

reference_ids.description: Batteries to set, up to 256: placed or rocket batteries, battery cells.

rocket_id.description: Every battery of this rocket (its id, its rocket network's or any part's).

in_id.description: Every battery cell in this thing's slots, nested slots too; "player" for the player.

ratio.description: The charge as a share of each battery's capacity; default full.

joules.description: The charge in joules, clamped to each battery's capacity; default full.
